recipes.name: Smoky Chicken Burrito Wrap
recipes.description: Batch-cooked chicken, rice, black beans, peppers and reduced-fat cheddar in a wholemeal tortilla.
ingredientLines: Salt, black pepper and optional fresh coriander
methodSteps: Dice the chicken and coat with the tomato purée, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic, onion granules, chilli, oregano, salt and pepper.
Heat half the oil in a large pan and cook the chicken until golden and cooked through.
Slice the peppers and onion. Cook in the remaining oil until softened but still slightly firm.
Stir in the drained black beans, cooked rice, chicken and lime juice.
Cool the filling promptly, then divide evenly between the 8 tortillas.
Add the cheddar and optional coriander. Fold tightly into burritos.
Optionally toast the sealed wraps briefly in a dry pan. Cool completely, wrap individually and freeze.
Reheat from frozen after removing foil, or defrost overnight in the fridge and reheat until piping hot throughout.
recipes.nutritionNote: Approximate starting estimate per wrap: 460 kcal, 43 g protein, 48 g carbohydrate, 11 g fat. Actual values depend on tortilla size, cooked rice weight, chicken yield and cheese brand. Recalculate when exact products/weights are known.

recipes.name: Slow-Braised Brisket & Pork Lasagne
recipes.description: Long-braised shredded beef brisket and pork mince ragù layered with Parmesan béchamel, pasta and mozzarella.
ingredientLines: Salt, black pepper and olive oil
60 g Parmesan, plus extra for topping
methodSteps: Season the brisket generously. Sear in a hot pan with a little oil until deeply browned on all sides; set aside.
In the same pan, brown the pork mince. Add finely diced onion, carrot and celery and cook for 8–10 minutes.
Add garlic and tomato purée; cook for 2 minutes. Deglaze with red wine, scraping up the browned fond.
Transfer to the slow cooker. Add tomatoes, stock, Worcestershire sauce, oregano, bay leaves and herbs. Nestle in the brisket.
Cook on LOW for approximately 8–9 hours, until the brisket pulls apart easily. Check doneness rather than relying on time alone.
Remove brisket, shred it and discard large pieces of connective tissue or excess fat. Remove bay leaves and herb stalks; return shredded beef to the sauce.
If the ragù is loose, reduce it uncovered in a saucepan until thick. Cool promptly if not assembling immediately.
For the béchamel, melt butter, stir in flour and cook for 2 minutes. Gradually whisk in milk; simmer until thick. Add Parmesan, nutmeg, salt and white pepper.
Layer ragù, lasagne sheets and béchamel. Repeat, finishing with béchamel, mozzarella and extra Parmesan.
Bake at 180°C fan for approximately 40–45 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest for 20 minutes before portioning.
For meal prep, cool promptly, divide into 10 portions and refrigerate or freeze. Reheat until piping hot throughout.
recipes.nutritionNote: Approximate planning estimate per 1/10 batch: 600 kcal, 44 g protein, 50 g carbohydrate, 25 g fat. This is provisional: brisket trim, pork mince fat %, pasta quantity, cheese and final cooked yield will materially change the result. Recalculate from actual ingredient labels and weights.

recipes.name: Korean Sticky Beef Bowls
recipes.description: Korean-inspired beef mince with gochujang, broccoli, edamame and jasmine rice.
methodSteps: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Brown the beef mince in a large non-stick pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add garlic and ginger; cook for 1 minute.
Mix gochujang, soy sauce and honey with 2 tbsp water. Add to the beef and simmer until glossy.
Steam broccoli and edamame until tender.
Divide rice, beef and vegetables between four containers. Finish with spring onion and sesame.
Refrigerate promptly; freeze the beef and rice portions if keeping longer. Reheat until piping hot.
recipes.nutritionNote: Planning estimate per serving. Actual macros depend on ingredient brands, trimming, cooking yield and portion weights; verify against product labels before treating as exact.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Turkey Kofta Bowls
recipes.description: Herby turkey koftas with wholewheat couscous, chopped salad, feta and lemon yoghurt.
ingredientLines: 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp paprika
methodSteps: Heat the oven to 200°C fan.
Mix turkey with cumin, coriander, paprika, oregano, crushed garlic, parsley, salt and pepper.
Shape into 12 small koftas and place on a lined tray. Bake for 18–22 minutes until cooked through.
Prepare couscous with boiling water according to the packet.
Chop tomatoes, cucumber and onion. Mix yoghurt with lemon juice and garlic.
Divide couscous, koftas and salad between four bowls. Add feta and lemon yoghurt.
Keep salad and yoghurt separate for best meal-prep texture.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken breast simmered in green curry and light coconut milk with crisp vegetables and jasmine rice.
methodSteps: Cook rice separately.
Dice chicken. Heat a large pan and brown chicken in batches.
Add curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in coconut milk and simmer gently until chicken is cooked through.
Add sliced peppers and green beans for the final 6–8 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; finish with basil.
Cool promptly. Freeze curry separately from rice for best texture; reheat until piping hot.

recipes.name: Mexican Pork Carnitas Bowls
recipes.description: Citrus, cumin and chipotle pulled pork with rice, black beans, corn and fresh salsa.
ingredientLines: 700 g lean pork loin or trimmed pork shoulder
2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano
Tomato, red onion and coriander for salsa
methodSteps: Put pork in a slow cooker with orange juice, lime juice, garlic, cumin, paprika, oregano and chipotle.
Cook on LOW for 6–8 hours (loin may cook sooner; shoulder generally needs longer) until tender and safely cooked.
Shred the pork and reduce the cooking liquid in a pan to make a glaze.
Cook rice. Warm beans and corn.
Make a fresh salsa from chopped tomato, red onion, coriander and lime.
Divide rice, pork, beans and corn into four portions. Add salsa when serving.
Freeze pork, rice and beans; add fresh salsa after reheating.

Coat chicken with remaining harissa, cumin, garlic and lemon zest.
Roast chicken on a separate tray until cooked through, then rest and slice.
Cook pearl couscous according to packet instructions. Stir through drained chickpeas and lemon juice.
Mix yoghurt with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Divide couscous, vegetables and chicken between four portions. Serve with yoghurt.

Season salmon with Cajun seasoning and bake for 12–15 minutes, depending on thickness, until just cooked.
Steam broccoli until tender.
Mix yoghurt with lemon juice, grated garlic and black pepper.
Divide salmon, sweet potato and broccoli between four plates or containers.

recipes.name: Italian Chicken Meatball Orzo
recipes.description: Lean chicken meatballs simmered with tomato, spinach and orzo, finished with Parmesan.
methodSteps: Mix chicken mince with egg, half the garlic, basil, oregano, salt and pepper. Shape into 16 meatballs.
Brown meatballs in a large deep pan; remove temporarily.
Add remaining garlic and chopped tomatoes. Pour in stock and bring to a simmer.
Stir in orzo and return meatballs to the pan. Simmer, stirring regularly, until orzo is tender and meatballs are cooked through; add water if needed.
Fold in spinach and Parmesan.
Divide into four portions. This thickens as it stands; loosen with a splash of water when reheating.

Stir-fry sliced carrots and pak choi in a large hot pan.

Add edamame, udon noodles and sauce. Toss until hot and evenly coated.

recipes.name: Lighter Indian Butter Chicken

methodSteps: Coat chicken pieces in yoghurt, garam masala, cumin, paprika, garlic and ginger. Marinate for at least 30 minutes if time allows.
Brown chicken in a non-stick pan; remove.
Melt butter, add a little garlic and ginger, then tomatoes and fenugreek. Simmer for 10 minutes; blend if a smooth sauce is preferred.
Return chicken and simmer until cooked through.
Stir in cream and spinach. Adjust seasoning.

recipes.name: Sausage, Egg & Cheese Breakfast Wraps
recipes.description: Freezer-friendly wholemeal breakfast burritos with lean turkey sausage, eggs, egg whites, potato, spinach and cheddar.
ingredientLines: 400 g lean turkey sausages, casings removed
methodSteps: Heat oven to 200°C fan. Dice potatoes into small cubes, toss with a little oil and roast for 20–25 minutes until golden and tender.
Remove sausage meat from casings if needed. Brown in a large non-stick pan, breaking it into small pieces.
Whisk eggs and egg whites. Scramble gently in a large pan until just set.
Fold cottage cheese, spinach and sliced spring onions through the eggs. Season with black pepper.
Divide sausage, egg mixture and roasted potato evenly between eight tortillas. Add cheddar.
Fold tightly into burritos. Toast seam-side down in a dry pan if desired.
Cool promptly, wrap individually and freeze. Defrost overnight in the fridge and reheat until piping hot, or reheat from frozen using a suitable microwave/oven method.

recipes.name: Lighter Chicken Katsu Curry
recipes.description: Oven-crisp panko chicken with a Japanese-style carrot and onion curry sauce and rice.
methodSteps: Heat oven to 200°C fan. Slice chicken breasts horizontally into even fillets.
Dip chicken in beaten egg, then coat in panko. Place on a wire rack over a tray and bake until golden and the thickest part reaches 75°C.
Cook rice separately.
Simmer finely chopped onion and grated carrot in chicken stock until soft.
Stir in curry roux until dissolved. Mix cornflour with cold water and add gradually to reach a coating consistency.
Slice chicken and serve over rice with curry sauce.
